# R5 / 14-label pair augmentation: complete f=0..3 finite theorem

Date 2026-11-20 (Asia/Shanghai); historical researcher EM-DIRECT-4C3E47; status AUTHOR_EXACT_FINITE_CHECKED / SELECTED_INDEPENDENT_CROSSCHECK / NOT_REVIEWED.

## Fixed scientific input

Repository awdawmip/enterprise-math@435e77af0d180eac32bd1f9c4c464bc4010b7551, file EXACT_R5_ALL_101_BUDGETS.json with SHA-256 50e87f0194cfb3780e84b7bbb6f9a2dca4f79bb4901cab06f1a5b59256fb470b, companion stages_18.json. Exactly 256 named scalar hypotheses, 101 physical query prices k=214..314, fixed robust endpoint tau=58182461585441404127941754879. A correct integer report y under h obeys 2|y-N_h(k)|<=tau; up to f response errors are unflagged. V_f(A) minimizes worst-case sum of query prices over adaptive strategies identifying h∈A.

Fix W=(0,16,32,48,1,64,17,80,18,24,34,82).

**Exact finite theorem:** for EVERY distinct u,v outside W, and for EVERY f∈{0,1,2,3},

    V_f(W union {u,v}) = 735 + 950*f.

This covers all C(244,2)=29,646 unordered two-name extensions, yielding 1,906 distinct price-aware *full joint* fourteen-label support signatures. Each signature representative was solved by exact integer Bellman recursion for f=0,1,2,3. Results: 735, 1685, 2635, 3585 respectively for all 29,646 pairs.

## Correct finite reduction

For query k, the possible correct-support mask is S_k(y)={i:2|y-N_i(k)|<=tau}. Every inclusion-maximal simultaneous support is witnessed by an integer-center window [N_i(k),N_i(k)+tau] (equivalently, a doubled left-endpoint construction). Enumerate all 14 named windows, remove masks properly included in others, and preserve actual prices. Superset supports are minimax-worse than their subsets, so only maximal supports matter. When two priced queries have identical maximal-mask families, the cheaper one dominates for all inconsistency states.

With counters e_i∈{0,...,f+1}, i is live iff e_i<=f. Under support S, e_i becomes min(f+1,e_i+1_{i notin S}). If at most one live label remains, V_f(e)=0; otherwise exact Bellman recursion is

    V_f(e)=min_{k: no maximal mask includes all live} {k + max_{S∈F_k} V_f(e^S)}.

An action allowing a no-progress adversarial response covering every live name cannot improve finite worst-case cost at positive price and can be skipped. Each retained branch advances some live counter, so recursion terminates. For f=0 the verified C++ program uses bit-subset DP; for f=1..3 its companion uses base-(f+2) integer-encoded counters. These retain all joint observations, unflagged errors and physical prices.

## Evidence, verification and limitations

Complete generated f0 pair map: 29,646 rows, SHA-256 9e6b3bc87aa8ad991038b1edace0f580ac4523f1d0327d92ce77e01693b0f1d8. Complete price-aware class ledgers for f1/f2/f3: 1,906 representatives each; all values uniform. Their SHA-256 hashes appear in RESULT.json. The largest signature class has 308 pairs. A separately coded Python oracle used doubled *left* interval endpoints and tuple-of-counters recursion on 11 separated signature classes: 44 independent comparisons at f=0..3, all passed. Independent full-class f1..3 recomputation, independent review and f>=4 classification remain open. An exploratory f=4 attempt was incomplete and is excluded from the theorem.

The earlier complete 13-label f=8 plateau still gives scalar lower bound 8335; this result does not change the old full-256 f=8 range 8335<=C_8*<=8343. Native BRC/X6/Port equivalence is not asserted. Preserve all named labels/observer provenance in any transfer.

## Next exact question

Compute f=4..8 for these 1,906 priced full 14-way support classes. Search for a pair with V_8(W union {u,v})>8335. Optimize with sound lower/upper certificates and inspect resource-heavy classes without extrapolating from f<=3.
